mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, or SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or NBER declares a recession within 6 months of the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or real GDP growth accelerates y/y during the signal period.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo for 2 months, or ISM Manufacturing PMI > 50 during the signal period.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >40% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% y/y, or existing home sales accelerate y/y during the signal period.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth accelerates by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a strengthening economy and potential inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts negative 20-day returns in >40% of instances where INDPRO growth accelerates by > 1% m/m, or core PCE inflation declines y/y during the signal period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and the consumer price index (CPI) are both rising simultaneously, it signals a tightening monetary policy and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >40% of instances where FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both rising, or real GDP growth accelerates y/y during the signal period.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail and food services sales decline by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer sector and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where RSAFS declines > 1% m/m, or consumer confidence rises during the signal period.
